title: x-unraid
description: Presentation metadata carried inside an ordinary compose file. Validates the x-unraid blocks and permits every other compose key, so it can be run against a whole compose file converted to JSON. Validate the SOURCE file converted to JSON, not `docker compose config` output, which has a history of stripping extension fields. There is nothing here for individual form fields: what a value is for is written in the comment beside it, which YAML already has and this schema cannot see.

version.description: Schema version. A reader seeing a higher major version falls back to inference rather than misreading the metadata.

name.description: Display name, and the last word on what the stack is called. Left out, a stack of one service is named after that service's container_name, or after the service key if it has none; a stack of several services is named after its directory.

category.description: Unraid's existing category taxonomy, e.g. MediaApp:Video.

icon.description: Four accepted forms, told apart by their shape: a full http(s) URL; a path relative to the stack directory, e.g. ./icon.png; a name from the selfh.st icon collection, e.g. jellyfin; or a Font Awesome glyph, e.g. fa-database, which is what Unraid's own XML templates accept. Omit it and the icon is matched automatically from the container's image name.

name.description: Display name for this service within the form. Defaults to the service key. It does not name the stack's own row in the list; only the stack-level name does that.

webui.description: Link to the container's web interface. Supports Unraid's [IP] and [PORT:nnnn] substitution; [PORT:nnnn] resolves the HOST port currently mapped to container port nnnn, so the link survives a port change.

display.description: 'advanced' hides the entire service behind the form's advanced toggle — for sidecars such as databases.
